c5bae920-a47f-4098-a5f6-6cd170601ba2.description_en: Inspired by summer meadow landscapes, this painting was created with professional oil paints on natural cotton canvas using the palette-knife technique. The knife work conveys the atmosphere of a flower field and the richness of its textures, while the abstract style gives the painting a sense of movement — like an open meadow where the flowers sway in a warm summer breeze.

48ad2a24-84cd-4446-b1b7-fd67a741dd08.description: Натхненна польовими літніми пейзажами, цю картину було створено за допомогою професійних олійних фарб на натуральному бавовняному полотні в техніці живопису мастихіну. Завдяки цій техніці, картина передає атмосферу квіткового поля та різноманіття його фактур. А стиль абстракції надає картині динаміку руху, як це буває на відкритій місцевості, коли квіти коливає теплий літній вітер.

settings.projects_intro_en:
Over 15 years of creative work I have painted more than 1,200 pictures in a wide range of techniques and styles. Every piece is special to me — I put a part of my soul, emotion and inspiration into each one. I remember my paintings, because each of them has its own story.

My works have already found homes in different corners of the world — in the USA, Canada, Italy, Turkey, the Czech Republic and China. Today they live with their owners, become part of their homes, fill the space with beauty and keep special moments.

This gallery shows only some of my favourite works — the ones especially dear to my heart. They are just part of a creative path built on years of inspiration, searching and love for art.

Every painting is more than a canvas. It is a part of my soul that lives on in the world.
settings.workshops_intro_en:
For five years I have been running my own on-site acrylic painting workshops — for two, a small group or a large team.

A workshop can take place outdoors, at your office, café or restaurant, or as part of a birthday, a corporate party or any other special occasion.

Everything you need is included: canvas, paints, brushes and other materials. You don't need to prepare or buy anything — I bring it all and help every participant create their own painting.

Tell me where, when and how many people there will be — I will suggest the best format, help you choose a subject and share all the details.

texts.Ваша кімната, світло, кольори, з якими ж: We discuss your idea and wishes. You send a photo of your space or a design visual, so we can see where the painting will go.
texts.Розробляю ескіз майбутньої роботи й пока: I work from a reference or develop an individual sketch for you. I make a visualisation from your photos or design project, so you can see how it will look on your walls at the right scale and in the right colours. We make changes if needed.
texts.Два–чотири тижні залежно від розміру. На:
A project takes 2–4 weeks on average, depending on the size and complexity.

When it is finished, I send photos and a video of the painting. Small changes are possible if needed.

After your “yes”, I pack the painting carefully and ship it to your address — your home or office.
